name.en: Romanian Government (MFA) Scholarships for Non-EU Citizens 2027/28
name.ka: რუმინეთის მთავრობის (საგარეო უწყების) სტიპენდიები არა-ევროკავშირის მოქალაქეებისთვის 2027/28
name.ar: المنح الحكومية الرومانية (وزارة الخارجية) لمواطني الدول غير الأعضاء في الاتحاد الأوروبي 2027/28

duration.en: 3-6 years (bachelor), 1-2 years (master), 4 years (PhD), plus a preparatory Romanian year if needed
duration.ka: 3-6 წელი (ბაკალავრი), 1-2 წელი (მაგისტრატურა), 4 წელი (დოქტორანტურა), საჭიროების შემთხვევაში რუმინული ენის მოსამზადებელი წელი
duration.ar: 3-6 سنوات (بكالوريوس)، 1-2 سنة (ماجستير)، 4 سنوات (دكتوراه)، مع سنة تحضيرية للغة الرومانية عند الحاجة

deadline_note: Annual call; the official portal shows no dates in its text and its banners suggest the 2026/27 round is closed. Check scholarships.studyinromania.gov.ro for the 2027/28 call.

summary.en: Romania's Ministry of Foreign Affairs awards state scholarships each year to citizens of non-EU countries for bachelor's, master's and PhD study at Romanian universities. Bachelor's and master's tuition is in Romanian, with a preparatory language year if needed.
summary.ka: რუმინეთის საგარეო საქმეთა სამინისტრო ყოველწლიურად გასცემს სახელმწიფო სტიპენდიებს არა-ევროკავშირის ქვეყნების მოქალაქეებისთვის ბაკალავრის, მაგისტრისა და დოქტორის დონეზე. ბაკალავრიატსა და მაგისტრატურაში სწავლება რუმინულ ენაზეა, საჭიროების შემთხვევაში მოსამზადებელი წლით.
summary.ar: تمنح وزارة الخارجية الرومانية سنوياً منحاً حكومية لمواطني الدول غير الأعضاء في الاتحاد الأوروبي للدراسة في الجامعات الرومانية في مستوى البكالوريوس والماجستير والدكتوراه. التدريس بالرومانية مع سنة تحضيرية للغة عند الحاجة.

about.en:
The Romanian state scholarship programme run through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is open to citizens of non-EU countries. It covers bachelor's (3 to 6 years), master's (1 to 2 years) and PhD (4 years) studies. Bachelor's and master's holders study in Romanian; students without Romanian take a preparatory language year unless they hold a B1 certificate, passed the Romanian test or had four years of Romanian schooling. PhD students may choose Romanian or a foreign language set by their doctoral school.

The official pages say state scholarships are paid in lei with amounts and numbers set by Government decision; personal expenses and international travel are not covered and dormitory accommodation is the student's responsibility. The official text does not state tuition coverage explicitly, so confirm in the call documents.

Applications go through the online portal in four steps: create an account, apply, get an answer, study in Romania. Candidates need an average of at least 7 (Romanian scale) or 'Good' in their last graduated school.

en: State scholarship for non-EU citizens at bachelor, master and PhD level
Single online application portal run by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
ka: სახელმწიფო სტიპენდია არა-ევროკავშირის მოქალაქეებისთვის ბაკალავრიდან დოქტორანტურამდე
ar: منحة حكومية لغير مواطني الاتحاد الأوروبي من البكالوريوس إلى الدكتوراه
بوابة إلكترونية موحدة تديرها وزارة الخارجية

eligibility.en: Citizens of non-EU countries; Georgia and Qatar are not mentioned on the official pages, so check the call. Excluded: ethnic Romanians abroad (separate programmes), people with protection status in Romania, diplomatic staff and families, and holders of a Romanian state scholarship for the same cycle. Needs a high-school diploma (bachelor), bachelor's degree (master) or master's (PhD) and an average of at least 7 on the Romanian scale or 'Good'.

en: Open the official scholarship portal and create an account
Check the call for the 2027/28 academic year when published
Submit the online application with academic documents
Wait for the answer, then follow the placement and language-year instructions

costs.en: State scholarship paid in Romanian lei (amount set by Government decision). International travel and personal expenses are not covered; dormitory accommodation is the student's responsibility. Tuition coverage is not stated on the pages checked.

score_reason: Open to all non-EU citizens, annual, but Romanian-medium study and unclear dates

name.en: Islamic University of Madinah Scholarships for International Students (Undergraduate, 1448 AH)
name.ka: მედინას ისლამური უნივერსიტეტის სტიპენდიები უცხოელი სტუდენტებისთვის (ბაკალავრიატი, 1448 ჰ.)
name.ar: منح الجامعة الإسلامية بالمدينة المنورة للطلاب الدوليين (البكالوريوس، العام 1448هـ)

deadline_note: The 1448 AH window ran 19 Apr to 21 May 2026 (announced 29 Jun 2026 page). The next window is expected around the same time in 2027; confirm on the university admissions page.

summary.en: The Islamic University of Madinah offers full and partial undergraduate scholarships to international applicants, applied for through the Study in Saudi platform. Applicants must be aged 17 to 25 with a secondary certificate from the last five years.
summary.ka: მედინას ისლამური უნივერსიტეტი სთავაზობს უცხოელ აპლიკანტებს სრულ და ნაწილობრივ საბაკალავრო სტიპენდიებს Study in Saudi პლატფორმის მეშვეობით. აპლიკანტი უნდა იყოს 17-25 წლის და ბოლო ხუთი წლის განმავლობაში დამთავრებული ჰქონდეს საშუალო სკოლა.
summary.ar: تقدم الجامعة الإسلامية بالمدينة المنورة منحاً كاملة وجزئية للبكالوريوس للمتقدمين الدوليين عبر منصة ادرس في السعودية. يشترط أن يكون عمر المتقدم بين 17 و25 عاماً وأن تكون شهادة الثانوية خلال آخر خمس سنوات.

about.en:
The university's scholarship admission announcement for 1448 AH covers internal and external, full and partial scholarships at bachelor level. Full-scholarship applicants must not reside in Saudi Arabia. Applications are submitted through the Study in Saudi platform.

Applicants need a secondary certificate (science track for science colleges) earned within the last five years, must be 17 to 25, in good conduct, medically fit, with a police clearance and an endorsement from a recognised body or academic figure in their country, and must pass any tests or interviews. The Quran college requires full memorisation of the Quran. For partial scholarships weighting is certificate plus aptitude (and achievement test for sciences).

The page does not itemise what a full scholarship covers; see the Undergraduate Admission Guide for Scholarship Students linked on the admissions page.

en: Full scholarships for applicants living outside Saudi Arabia
Ages 17 to 25, certificate from the last five years
Apply on the Study in Saudi platform in the annual spring window
ka: სრული სტიპენდია საუდის არაბეთს გარეთ მცხოვრებთათვის
განაცხადი Study in Saudi პლატფორმაზე ყოველწლიურ საგაზაფხულო პერიოდში
ar: العمر 17-25 وشهادة خلال آخر خمس سنوات
التقديم عبر منصة ادرس في السعودية في نافذة الربيع السنوية

eligibility.en: International applicants (nationality restrictions not listed; Georgia and Qatar are not mentioned). Secondary certificate from the last 5 years, age 17-25, not resident in Saudi Arabia (full scholarship), good conduct, medical fitness, police clearance, endorsement letter, no prior scholarship from a Saudi institution, and passing tests/interviews.

en: Create a profile on the Study in Saudi platform
Check the Undergraduate Admission Guide for Scholarship Students on the university admissions page
Provide certificate, police clearance and endorsement
Sit tests or interviews if invited

costs.en: Full and partial scholarships exist; the announcement does not itemise benefits. Consult the admission guide.

score_reason: Full scholarship for international bachelors, annual window; strict conditions
